verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official CLI and data exports (PGP-encrypted JSON, ZIP, CSV), but nothing about a public API or a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Data export files and a CLI are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API specification. Probes for llms.txt and markdown docs also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
